vetSays.line: 🛡️ Siobhan, Anjali, Ivy and Ella met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Siobhan, Anjali, Ella are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Anjali, Piper, Navjot, Jun and Ella met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Anjali, Navjot, Jun, Ella are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ella just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Siobhan, Anjali, Ivy, Ella and Amina met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Anjali, Ivy, Ella are hurt.
🛡️ Siobhan, Ivy, Amina, Olivia and Nikos met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Siobhan, Ivy, Olivia, Nikos are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Ivy, Amina, Olivia, Nikos and Valeria met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Ivy, Olivia, Nikos, Valeria are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Toby met them at the door — 1 put down. Toby is hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Loud-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Loud-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Loud-Eyes!
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Toby just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Soledad, Toby and Rafael met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Soledad, Toby, Rafael are hurt.
💬 Rafael has been asking Ivy about Cold-Blooded — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Rafael taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Yerlan showed Toby the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.

Ivy has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Rafael passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
